{{Top}}
[[File:QuickDrawHolsters-Db.png|thumb|right|250px|[[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane's]] [[quickdraw holster]]s]]
'''Holsters''' were used to carry [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. Numerous types of specialized holsters existed. [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] had a holster made from [[Shaak/Legends|Shaak]] hide and used one to carry her [[ELG-3A blaster pistol/Legends|Naboo Royal pistol]]. Holsters were used by members of the [[Krozurbian]] [[Krozurbian War Council|War Council]].<ref name="SOR4">[[Droids (1995) 8|''Droids'' (1995) 8]]</ref>

Quickdraw holster were designed to allow an individual to very rapidly draw their [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]]. This was partly achieved by removing the strap used to secure the blaster in place which was found on common holsters. The notorious [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] had dual quick-draw holsters for his twin modified [[LL-30 blaster pistol/Legends|LL-30 blaster pistols]]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] also carried his custom [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 heavy blaster pistol]] in a quickdraw holster.
